parsed_output.refined_idea: Develop a lightweight application that lets small‑household cooks manually record the ingredients they have and their approximate expiry dates, then provides tailored meal suggestions and tracks self‑reported food waste to evaluate behavioral change.
parsed_output.core_mechanism: A web/mobile app where users manually input pantry items and approximate expiration dates, receive meal suggestions based on that data, and log post‑cooking waste through simple questionnaires.
parsed_output.core_mechanism_justification: Manual entry respects user control, avoids reliance on model‑generated data, and directly matches the human intent to test whether pantry‑aware suggestions reduce waste.

accepted_changes.proposal: Adopt manual pantry entry as the core mechanism
accepted_changes.promotion_reason: Aligns with the explicit user intention and avoids circular model hypotheses
accepted_changes.evidence_or_decision_basis: User intent and feasibility of rapid prototyping

candidate_possibilities: Add optional barcode scanning to auto‑populate pantry items (requires computer‑vision models)
Create a gamified platform with points for logging inventory and waste images
Partner with grocery retailers to infer pantry stock from purchase histories

rejected_changes.proposal: Implement automatic barcode scanning and computer‑vision extraction as the primary data source
rejected_changes.reason_rejected: Relies on MODEL_HYPOTHESIS for core data, introducing circular authority and privacy concerns

rejected_changes.proposal: Use retailer purchase histories as the main inventory source
rejected_changes.reason_rejected: Depends on external data agreements and reduces personalization, making it unsuitable for the core mechanism

remaining_uncertainties: Accuracy of user‑provided pantry and expiry information
User willingness to consistently log waste data
Effectiveness of suggested meals in changing cooking habits
known_risks: Potential low adoption due to manual entry burden
Privacy concerns if data is stored centrally
parsed_output.recommended_next_step: Build a minimal viable prototype of the manual entry app, recruit a small cohort of one‑to‑two‑person households, collect baseline waste data, run a short pilot to assess suggestion impact, and iterate based on user feedback.
